product_metadata.title: Large Salad Bowl, Circular Shaped In Premium Acrylic Break Resistant Clear, 146 Ounce 2 Count
features: This perfect high grade decorative bowl allows food to be the centerpiece of the table. 9-1/2" diameter x 4-3/4" H, 146oz, Set of 2 break-resistant.
Large size ideal for serving family side dishes and snacks, like pasta, salad and popcorn.

It is made from premium acrylic plastic, 100% food safe, BPA free materials. For full comfortable use, this fruit vegetable bowl is made of heavy gauge durable materials, which is eco-friendly and recyclable.

Its generous size and durability are suited for both indoor and outdoor entertaining and blends in with any style of decor. Perfect for weddings, parties, big family dinners or any event where food will be served.
The sleek modern look is perfect for use at home, work, or restaurant. And easy to clean, Not used hot water !!! You can wipe it up with a dishcloth.
